title: Revolutionary metal lid Orbit™: simple twist, big difference
summary: Metal lid Orbit™ embracing inclusivity in every twist.
body_markdown:
## Metal lid Orbit™ embracing inclusivity in every twist


Metal lid Orbit™ is a breakthrough in inclusive design. Designed with inclusivity at its core, Orbit™ offers effortless access and a seamless opening experience for everyone regardless of age or physical ability, eliminating the struggle commonly associated with traditional lids.


This revolutionary metal lid prioritises ease of opening, fostering greater independence and convenience in daily life. Experience the difference of an inclusive design that truly understands and caters to diverse needs. Say goodbye to frustration and hello to ease – because everyone deserves accessibility.


[Contact Us for More Details](https://www.sonoco.com/emea/contact-europe-middle-east-africa)


## Simple twist, easy pop - revolutionary opening


Metal lid Orbit™ features a unique mechanism that reduces the force required to open a jar by up to 50% compared to traditional threaded lids. Its innovative design includes a central, vacuum-sealed, floating lid and an outer ring that acts as the opening and closing device.


This means a simple twist is all it takes to break the seal and hear a popping sound, making it so easy to use for everyone.


## Orbit™ Success Continues: the revolutionary metal lid is now available in 66mm


Metal lid Orbit™ is now available in the market’s most popular size – 66mm! We’re thrilled to introduce the latest advancement in accessibility and ease of use: the Orbit™ lid, now offered in the widely sought-after 66mm size. This new addition ensures that even more consumers can enjoy the effortless opening experience that Orbit™ is known for, validating our commitment to consumer satisfaction and innovation. The success of Orbit™ is the reason why we now make it more widely available in the 66mm diameter.
